from solution import zero_segment_sums
assert zero_segment_sums('2,-1,0,4,3,0,0,-2') == '1,7,-2'
assert zero_segment_sums('0,0') == ''
assert zero_segment_sums('1,2') == '3'
assert zero_segment_sums('1, 0') is None
assert zero_segment_sums('1002') is None
